purpose.public_purpose: Help adults discover and book small in-person craft workshops without feeling overwhelmed by a course marketplace.
purpose.primary_outcome: A visitor finds a suitable workshop and completes a booking request.
success_signals: Visitors can compare upcoming workshops by date, skill level, and available places
The booking path is understandable without account creation
The full primary journey remains usable by keyboard and at 320 CSS pixels
trust_requirements: Show real instructors and venue details
State price, materials, accessibility, cancellation, and duration before booking

audience.primary: Adults interested in trying a practical craft workshop locally
audience.context_of_use: Browsing on a phone after seeing a social post or searching for a weekend activity
risks: Overly artistic layout hiding practical details
Mobile booking controls obscured by sticky elements

surfaces.purpose: Explain the workshop concept and route visitors to suitable upcoming sessions.
Let visitors compare current sessions without losing important practical information.
Provide every decision detail and start a booking request.

primary_journeys: Social or search entry → upcoming workshop scan → detail → booking request → confirmation
Home → how it works → workshop list → detail
experience_map.completion_path: A booking or waitlist request returns a visible confirmation, sends an email receipt, and offers a clear next step.
experience_map.navigation_model: Simple top-level navigation with Home, Workshops, How it works, and Visit; workshop detail preserves a clear return to the filtered list.

visual_grammar.dominant_idea: A contemporary workshop noticeboard combining tactile paper detail with clear editorial scheduling.
typography_roles: Warm display serif for workshop names
Highly legible sans serif for schedules, forms, and practical details
Tabular numerals for dates, duration, price, and places
colour_roles: Deep green action and focus colour
Clay accent reserved for dates and availability
Semantic status colours with text labels
layout_rules: Date and availability remain visually adjacent
Practical details appear before long editorial description
Artwork may overlap frames but never booking controls
Desktop uses asymmetric editorial columns; narrow screens use a direct single-column decision order
visual_grammar.spacing_density: Airy around editorial imagery, compact and regular around schedule and booking information.
visual_grammar.imagery_treatment: Real workshop process photography with natural crop, visible materials, and no artificial yellow grading.
component_language: Workshop cards behave as schedule entries rather than generic floating cards
Filters use native controls with explicit applied-state summary
Booking appears in a focused dialog on wide screens and a full route or full-height sheet on narrow screens

interaction_rules: Filtering updates the result summary and URL without moving keyboard focus unexpectedly
Booking state is recoverable after validation errors
Availability is always expressed with text, not colour alone
transition_grammar: Workshop thumbnail may transition into the detail hero as progressive enhancement
Filter changes use a short local cross-fade without moving the page
Dialog entry is a restrained opacity and vertical offset
scroll_rules: Sticky booking summary is disabled when viewport height is constrained
motion_purposes: Preserve continuity from list to detail
Confirm filtering and booking state changes
reduced_motion: Remove shared-element travel and use an immediate route change
Replace dialog travel with an immediate opacity change
Keep focus movement and status announcements unchanged
focus_behaviour: Detail route focus moves to the workshop heading after navigation
Booking dialog receives focus on its heading and returns focus to the invoking button on close
Validation errors focus the summary, with linked fields
loading_error_feedback: Errors explain what failed and provide retry
Booking submission prevents duplicate requests while retaining entered values

compositions.name: wide editorial
compositions.trigger: The main content container can support imagery and decision information side by side.
layout_changes: Keep booking summary visible in the secondary column
interaction_changes: Booking opens in a modal dialog

compositions.name: short laptop
compositions.trigger: Viewport height is too small for a persistent secondary booking column.
layout_changes: Keep action inline after practical details
interaction_changes: Dialog height is bounded with internal content scrolling only when necessary

compositions.name: narrow
compositions.trigger: Available inline size no longer supports two decision columns.
layout_changes: Place availability and primary action before the long description
Use full-width media with approved crop
interaction_changes: Booking becomes a dedicated route or full-height sheet
content_priority_changes: Practical details move before instructor biography

reflow_320_css_px: Sticky controls do not obscure focused content
intrinsic_media_rules: All workshop images declare intrinsic dimensions
Use art-directed sources where the focal making action differs by crop

implementation.architecture: Server-rendered content site with progressively enhanced filtering and booking interactions.
conventions: Semantic HTML and native controls first
Design tokens own colour, type, spacing, and focus
Booking and catalogue state have explicit loading and error models
editable_areas: Component details within the visual grammar
Motion timing within the declared ranges
browser_support: Full function without View Transition API
public_private_boundary: Private attendee details remain server-side and are not embedded in public pages
Internal capacity notes are excluded from public API responses
implementation.rollback_boundary: Each implementation batch must be reversible without replacing approved photography or catalogue data.

required_views: 320 CSS-pixel reflow for home, list, detail, and booking
required_interactions: Keyboard navigation from home to booking confirmation
Filter apply, clear, and empty result
Dialog or sheet open, close, escape, and focus return
accessibility_checks: Zoom, text spacing, and 320 CSS-pixel reflow
performance_checks: LCP resource and hero image review
CLS during image, filter, and availability loading
INP for filters and booking submission
security_checks: Public bundle and API response inspection
Direct access and authorization review for private booking data
evidence_contract.freshness_rule: Any change to layout, content priority, booking behaviour, protected imagery, or responsive rules stales the affected evidence.

revision_history.summary: Initial buildable contract for the example workshop booking experience.
